title: Remarkable drug-like properties of mixed ligand coordination compounds having dicarboxylic acid: synthesis, characterization, molecular docking and DFT studies.
authors: Mohamed Nasar, Nazeer; Samuel, Michael; Selvaraj, Freeda Selva Sheela; Alagumuthu, Manikandan; Jeyaraman, Porkodi; Raman, Natarajan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究混合配体金属配合物的合成、表征及DNA结合与分子对接，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作和分子对接，但核心是药物化学性质，非TF-DNA结合机制建模，方法深度有限。
abstract: Four mixed ligand metal complexes have been synthesized from ortho-phenylenediamine (OPD) Schiff base and a dicarboxylic acid (succinic acid). Using spectral examinations in the UV-Vis, FT-IR, mass, electron paramagnetic resonance, and nuclear magnetic resonance, the prepared ligand and the complexes have been characterized. Numerous methodologies have been employed to examine pharmacological activities, including those related to anti-oxidant, anti-microbial, and DNA binding. Utilizing the B3LYP/6-31G (d) basis set and the Gaussian-09 program, the Density Functional theory investigations have optimized the ligand and its metal complexes' molecular structures in order to investigate the theoretical properties. Furthermore, all complexes involving the interacting amino acids of the bacterial kinase (PDB ID: 7VKB) and fungal kinase (PDB ID: 6U6A) underwent molecular docking studies. In the results, metal complex [CuL(L(1))] showed good DNA binding ability, antimicrobial (Lowest MIC 1.3 microg/mL), antifungal (Lowest MIC 1.2 microg/mL) and anioxidant (Lowest IC(50) 2.0 microg/mL) activities which ensure the good drug candidacy potentials of [CuL(L(1))].
abstract_zh: 以邻苯二胺（OPD）席夫碱和二元羧酸（丁二酸）为原料，合成了四种混合配体金属配合物。通过紫外-可见光谱、傅里叶变换红外光谱、质谱、电子顺磁共振和核磁共振等光谱检测手段，对制备的配体及其配合物进行了表征。采用多种方法考察了其药理活性，包括抗氧化、抗菌和DNA结合活性。利用B3LYP/6-31G (d)基组和Gaussian-09程序，通过密度泛函理论（Density Functional Theory）研究优化了配体及其金属配合物的分子结构，以探讨其理论性质。此外，所有涉及细菌激酶（PDB ID: 7VKB）和真菌激酶（PDB ID: 6U6A）相互作用氨基酸残基的配合物均进行了分子对接研究。结果表明，金属配合物[CuL(L(1))]表现出良好的DNA结合能力、抗菌活性（最低MIC为1.3微克/毫升）、抗真菌活性（最低MIC为1.2微克/毫升）和抗氧化活性（最低IC(50)为2.0微克/毫升），这确保了[CuL(L(1))]具有良好的药物候选潜力。
